shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

ls node_modules | grep -iE 'mark|remark|md|dompurify|highlight' ; ls node_modules/@uiw; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; grep -oE '"(TextArea|Text|Card|Label|Button|TextInput)"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100
timeout 20 npm view marked version 2>&1 | tail -3; node --version
npm install react-markdown@^9 remark-gfm@^4 2>&1 | tail -5 && cat node_modules/react-markdown/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -oE "'[a-z]+-[0-9]'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; sed -n 1,30p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Link/Link.d.ts; grep -oE "'[a-z-]+'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -rn "g-color-base-generic\b\|--g-color-line-generic\b\|--g-color-base-float\b\|--g-color-text-secondary\b\|--g-border-radius-m\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles

grep -oE 'text_variant_[a-z0-9-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.css | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -ohE -- '--g-(color-(base-generic|line-generic|text-secondary|base-float|text-primary|base-misc-light|text-link|line-brand)|border-radius-m|text-code-font-family|text-code-1-font-size|text-code-1-line-height|text-body-1-font-size|spacing-[0-9])\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/variables.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes; grep -rn "ControlGroupProps" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -30
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -iE 'playwright|puppeteer'; echo "---"; echo done
cp /tmp/smoke.test.tsx src/__smoke.test.tsx && npx vitest run src/__smoke.test.tsx --server.deps.inline="@gravity-ui/uikit" 2>&1 | tail -25; rm -f src/__smoke.test.tsx

sed 's#/tmp/vitest.smoke.config.ts##' /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.ts > vitest.smoke.config.ts && cp /tmp/smoke.test.tsx src/__smoke.test.tsx && npx vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | tail -25; rm -f src/__smoke.test.tsx vitest.smoke.config.ts; rm -rf dist; git status --short
